profile.name: 数字X射线脉冲处理器（DXP）/多道分析系统
profile.name_en: Digital X-ray Processor (DXP) / Multichannel Analyzer System
profile.description: 这是一类用于X射线探测器读出的数字脉冲处理与多道能谱分析电子学设备，可连接一个或多个通道，对探测器输出脉冲进行处理、计数并生成能谱数据。它常用于X射线荧光、能量色散谱以及同步辐射实验中的能谱采集与映射测量。
profile.description_en: This is a digital pulse-processing and multichannel spectroscopy electronics system for X-ray detectors. It can serve one or more detector channels, process detector pulses, count events, and produce energy spectra. It is commonly used for X-ray fluorescence, energy-dispersive spectroscopy, and synchrotron-based spectral acquisition and mapping measurements.

registry.name: EPICS DXP Digital X-ray Processor X射线衍射仪
registry.description: EPICS DXP Digital X-ray Processor X射线衍射仪是由XIA LLC生产的X射线衍射仪，主要功能包括停止。支持Signal, Slot, add rois等操作。
